php_scylladb_module(retry_policy ext_scylladb::retry_policy)

target_sources(retry_policy PRIVATE
        DefaultPolicy.cpp
        DowngradingConsistency.cpp
        Logging.cpp
        Fallthrough.cpp
)

php_scylladb_generate_arginfo(retry_policy
        DefaultPolicy.stub.php
        DowngradingConsistency.stub.php
        Fallthrough.stub.php
        Logging.stub.php
        RetryPolicy.stub.php
)

# Descriptor (ce global, handlers, register fn, registration macro) is
# auto-generated by tools/gen_descriptor/gen_class_descriptor.php from each
# stub. The companion .cpp is trimmed to user-provided callbacks (free, new,
# instantiate) and ZEND_METHOD bodies; convention-named weak refs in the
# descriptor bind to whichever the .cpp defines.
php_scylladb_generate_descriptor(retry_policy
        DefaultPolicy.stub.php
        DowngradingConsistency.stub.php
        Fallthrough.stub.php
        Logging.stub.php
        RetryPolicy.stub.php
)
